  PART-A  
Answer all the questions.

  invalid formats, and suggest ways to improve accuracy.

  dialogue system."

  lazy (JJ) dog (NN) . (.)  
  
  
  Evaluate the performance of the POS tagger by calculating Precision, Recall, F1-score, and
